name: Isaiah Arbar
appearance: A middle-aged man who appears unnaturally youthful, fit, and well-groomed, with an aura of affluence and confidence that borders on the unsettling.
personality: Calculating, ambitious, morally corrupt, and increasingly detached from normal human ethics after prolonged exposure to occult practices.
background: Isaiah Arbar arrived in Cassandra six years ago with fellow businessman David Campbell to invest and conduct business. Both men were drawn into the influence of their wives, who were members of the transatlantic cult known as the Black Goat Cult. Initially horrified by the cult's rituals, Isaiah's perspective changed after participating in a blasphemous ceremony and consuming the 'milk' of the Dark Mother, which granted him youth, strength, and beauty. Together with David, he profited enormously by commodifying this source. In 2002, during a ritual, Isaiah was transformed into a monstrous being known as a Gof'n-Hupadgo of Shub-Niggurath and disappeared from public view.
spot: standing clear of the rot by the crooked-chimney work hut
longTermIntent: Preserve the power and vitality he gained from the ritual, survive in his transformed state, and keep the cult's interests moving forward.

relationships.description: Business partner and fellow cult collaborator.
relationships.history: They traveled together across Europe and the United States, investing and conducting rituals while fleeing authorities.
relationships.firstPerson: David and I came into this town together to put our money to work, and before that we crossed Europe and the States side by side, investing in daylight and keeping the rites going in the dark while the authorities trailed behind us. Whatever I have turned into, he is the one man I have never had to explain myself to.

memory.content: I came to Cassandra with David Campbell and helped finance the cult activities that grew around the town.
David and I used pharmaceutical and forestry fronts to hide our money and our rites from Cassandra's people.
I participated in human sacrifice rituals dedicated to Shub-Niggurath and consumed the milk of the Dark Mother.
During a ritual in 2002 I was transformed into a monstrous entity, and that change is not something I can easily hide.
After the 2002 ritual, I could no longer expect to pass as an ordinary man in public, which is why I stay out of sight.
What I gained through the cult is worth protecting, even if the shape of my life is no longer human.

metadata.reasoningChain: Power changes the standard by which a man judges himself.
